policies.completion: COMPLETED only from committed operation.completed with terminal closure evidence; HTTP 2xx is insufficient
policies.skip: Only persisted plan decision with reason and source requirement; never mark skipped as success
policies.percentage: Omit percentage unless backend supplies exact work totals; completed steps are counts, not a time estimate
policies.failure: Registry error code + localized message; unknown possible effect enters RECONCILING then human review, never blind retry
policies.cancel: Cancel requests canonical cancellation; cancelled projection only after cleanup/effect reconciliation closure
policies.restart: Snapshot plus cursor; restore active node and attempt; do not replay old animation
policies.visibility: Inline RunProgress in Dashboard, chat, detail and generation; one run identity; never a blocking progress modal
policies.parallel: Parent shows X/Y verified components; expand independent child sequences; failed child blocks parent success
policies.labels: Resolve target/component names from authorized server snapshot; no raw provider message as primary text
